package design

import . "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/dsl"

var blob = Type("OccurrenceBlob", Bytes, func() {
	Meta("openapi:typename:canonical", "true")
})
var viewed = ResultType("application/vnd.occurrence", func() {
	Attributes(func() {
		Attribute("data", blob)
		Attribute("value", blob, func() {
			Nullable()
			Default([]byte("default"))
		})
		Required("data")
	})
	View("default", func() {
		Attribute("data")
		Attribute("value")
	})
	View("tiny", func() {
		Attribute("value")
		Attribute("data")
	})
})
var _ = Service("svc", func() {
	Method("send", func() {
		Result(viewed)
		HTTP(func() { GET("/view") })
	})
})
